spec.description:
Kingspan Kooltherm K3 Floorboard is a premium performance, fiber-free rigid
thermoset phenolic insulation board engineered specifically for concrete
ground-bearing and suspended floors. Featuring an ultra-low thermal conductivity
of 0.021 - 0.023 W/m·K, it provides maximum thermal efficiency with minimal
thickness, making it ideal for new build concrete slabs and retrofit floor
systems. With a closed-cell structure and glass tissue facings autohesively
bonded to the core, it resists ground moisture and helps achieve 7-star NatHERS
ratings.
features:
Thermal conductivity of 0.021 - 0.023 W/m·K, the
thinnest commonly used underfloor board

Purpose-designed for installation
beneath concrete slab-on-ground or above suspended concrete floors

Simplifies
the path to 7-star NatHERS residential energy efficiency compliance

High
compressive strength (≥ 150 kPa) supports residential and light commercial slab
loads

Fiber-free closed-cell phenolic core; resistant to ground moisture and
mold growth
Autohesively bonded glass tissue facings on both sides

Reduces ground heat loss (which
accounts for up to 49% of heat loss in cold climate zones)

Locally
manufactured in Australia with zero ODP blowing agents

Global GreenTag
GreenRate Level A certified with verified EPD

install:
Prepare level, well-compacted
sub-base blinding layer (sand or lean-mix concrete)

Lay damp-proof membrane
(DPM / 0.2mm polyethylene vapor barrier) over the blinding layer with 150mm
taped overlaps

Lay Kooltherm K3 Floorboards tightly butted in a staggered
brick-bond pattern over the DPM

For suspended floors, lay boards over flat
concrete slab surface

Cut boards neatly around internal plumbing and service
penetrations with a fine-toothed hand saw

Place a separating slip-sheet
(0.2mm polythene) over the boards with taped 150mm overlaps to prevent concrete
slurry ingress

Place bar chairs and reinforcement mesh over the separating
layer, taking care not to puncture the insulation

Pour concrete slab directly
over the assembly
selection_checklist:
Confirm application is
slab-on-ground or suspended concrete floor

Verify required R-value (e.g. 25mm
R1.1, 50mm R2.15) from 7-star NatHERS assessment

Check compressive load
requirements (K3 provides ≥ 150 kPa for residential/light commercial loads)

Order matching damp-proof membrane and Kingspan GreenGuard GG350 slab edge
insulation
limitations:
For concentrated industrial heavy forklift loads, specify
high-compressive XPS (e.g. GreenGuard GG500)

Must be installed with a
continuous damp-proof membrane beneath

Protect boards from site traffic prior
to concrete pouring

retrieval.rag_summary:
Kingspan Kooltherm K3 Floorboard is an ultra-thin, fiber-free
rigid thermoset phenolic insulation board engineered specifically for concrete
ground-bearing and suspended floors. With a thermal conductivity of 0.021
- 0.023 W/m·K and thicknesses from 25mm to 90mm (R1.1 to R3.9), it provides
superior thermal resistance at minimal thickness to prevent ground heat loss and
achieve 7-star NatHERS compliance. Built with high compressive strength (≥ 150
kPa) and autohesively bonded glass tissue facings, it is CodeMark certified and
moisture-resistant.
